notes: A public-API translation of the native-green 38-assertion pending time-regulation callback restore case. The federate saves and restores while an Enable Time Regulation callback remains gated: HLA_EVOKED uses the callback-service gate, and HLA_IMMEDIATE uses Disable/Enable Callbacks. After restore, exactly one Time Regulation Enabled callback and one Federation Saved/Restored completion are observed, without replaying stale pre-restore work. Isolated C++ primary/contract passed against installed 2026-10-20 package libraries under evoked/immediate callback models and integer64/float64 time (eight runs). The adapter supplies provider libraries, endpoint, IEEE 1516.2-2025 FOM, logical-time implementation, and callback model. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR; Java provider runtime, process-restart durability, interoperability, and conformance remain unverified. The separately investigated timed regional-attribute restore case is not promoted because its fresh native run fails at restored source-region identity.
